content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 12.4 (second instance), ¶ p0046 — a non-compete binding *us*: no developing, marketing, selling, or acquiring any competing product or service, term plus 24 months, any territory.
- **Classification:** Fails every fallback element (unnamed/undefined scope, post-term tail, no internal-development or acquisition carve-outs) and the 24-month post-term restraint is walk-away territory.
- **Conflict noted:** § 12.3 (p0044) expressly states Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete… commitment," so the retained clause was internally inconsistent; the edit resolves that conflict without a "notwithstanding" override.
- **Other locations checked:** § 12.4 (first instance, no-hire — separate rule), § 13.4 (acceptable use), § 24.2 (restriction on Vendor, benefits us) — no other Customer non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** flip the operator and drop the duration — "During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop" → "Customer may develop", achieving the preferred position with a single minimal edit; fallback narrowing offered in the comment.
